params.prompt: SUBJECT: a tall narrow tide ledger seen from the spine side: a vertical hardbound ledger standing upright, wet-metal blue-grey #36565C cloth spine with two pale cyan salt-stained bands, no lettering on the spine. The dominant shape is a tall narrow vertical rectangle. Painterly semi-realistic game UI icon: the object alone, centered, filling most of a square frame, on a plain flat records-paper off-white #E7E3D8 background with a faint soft shadow, no environment, no hands. Even diffuse light, matte, worn by salt and use. Palette limited to seal ink #173238, wet-metal blue-grey #36565C, verdigris bronze #4F7A6B, wet-concrete grey #8A8E88, salt-crystal pale cyan #C8D6D3 and one small ochre accent #E2AF62. The silhouette must read as ONE clear shape at 32 px. NEGATIVE: no text, no letters, no numbers, no arrows, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no neon, no glossy CGI render, no lens flare, no bloom, no red warning lights, no chrome, no brand marks, no anime style.
